dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: Uh... Hello?

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: If you don't have anything urgent, I must really continue deliberating this matter with Sir Matsukawa...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: I am of the Takatsukasa family of the Kujou Clan. I work for the Shogunate.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: The Kanjou Commission has recently submitted some new financial reports. I'm currently reviewing and organizing them to report to my superior.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: But my superior seems to be a bit worried about this report.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: Sir Matsukawa has been in office for many years, earning him immense prestige and respect. If he is worried about this report, then I must be more prudent in my review...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the problem with the report?

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: In my humble opinion, there is nothing wrong with the report. The Kanjou Commission has been very careful in submitting their report, and I have already reviewed it according to our usual standards.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: But perhaps with the current unrest, Sir Matsukawa is less than optimistic about the financial situation in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: I can understand his concern... But as an ordinary civil official, what can I do to help...?

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: *sigh* If I had more power, perhaps I could resolve these issues and actually do something for the Takatsukasa and Kujou Clans.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry for bothering you.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: Alright. Then I will get back to work...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, you are...

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: I am of the Takatsukasa family of the Kujou Clan. I work for the Shogunate.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: The Kanjou Commission has recently submitted some new financial reports. I'm currently reviewing and organizing them to report to my superior.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: Ever since the abolishing of the Vision Hunt Decree, Sir Matsukawa has been even more cautious about the materials he sends to the Kanjou Commission. I must be vigilant, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the problem with the reports?

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: Well, you see, the abolishing of the Decree caused a huge stir. This also exposed many instances of nepotism and fraud within the Kanjou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: We've currently got our hands full clearing the old accounts.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: And with the war ending with the Shogunate being unable to decisively defeat the rebels, Sir Matsukawa is even less optimistic about the financial situation in Inazuma than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: The work on my hands has grown significantly, and the paper pushers below me have not been all that useful in this matter, so I have had no choice but to follow Sir Matsukawa through this work every step of the way.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the situation in the Kujou Clan...

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: Being as busy as we are, I have not paid the clan's internal affairs much mind... So the news that some in our family tried to stab the main Kujou Clan in the back, I was very shocked...

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: It is fortunate that Lord Kujou Kamaji was able to gain the Almighty Shogun's trust. If not... *sigh* I dare not even think about the consequences.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: Still, this series of events has me thinking that I should pay our internal affairs more mind... Once I have finished my work here, I will pay the main clan a visit...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't let me bother you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Takatsukasa Tomohide
dialogues.text: Alright. Then I shall return to my work...
